text: これ　あげるから　もっていきなさい

patterns.name: 〜から (reason)
patterns.explanation: から after a verb means 'because' or 'so'. これ　あげるから = 'I'll give you this, so'.

patterns.name: 〜なさい
patterns.explanation: なさい is a firm but kindly order, the way an elder speaks to a child. もっていきなさい = 'take it with you'.

patterns.name: 〜ていく
patterns.explanation: いく after a て-verb means doing something and then going away. もって　いく is 'hold and go'. もっていきなさい = 'take it along'.
